components.name: WebSocket Server Initialization
components.details: Starts Fleck WebSocket server on ws://127.0.0.1:3784. Registers OnOpen, OnClose, and OnMessage handlers for OBS Browser Source clients.

components.name: Media Server Initialization
components.details: Starts HttpListener on http://localhost:6211/. Routes requests for local static assets (MP4, WebM, WebP, PNG, Live2D Moc3, Atlas, JSON).

components.name: MIME Type Resolution
components.details: Maps file extensions to standard MIME headers: video/mp4, video/webm, image/webp, image/png, application/json, etc.

components.name: Broadcast State Dispatch
components.details: Serializes JSON payload and broadcasts asynchronously to all active WebSocket client sessions.

components.name: Team State Sync
components.details: Constructs snapshot of PK match state (scores, round time remaining, combo streaks, leaderboards) and broadcasts to port 3784.
